en.headline: Frontend Developer
en.summary: I am Jonathan Arevalo, a Front-End Developer from Colombia. I build clean, reusable and scalable web experiences with React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
en.detail: My focus is frontend architecture, microfrontends, ecommerce, automation and integrations that turn ideas into maintainable digital products.
en.learningCopy: I am strengthening my backend and cloud profile with Python, Java and AWS, while keeping Linux as part of my daily technical workflow.
studies: Technologist in Analysis and Development of Information Systems
